diagnosis: Job EXP-40233 (~6 GB, running ~7 hours in eu-central) exceeds the six-hour stall threshold from kb-0005, so it should be cancelled and resubmitted. No escalation per policy; priority routing applies per kb-0016.
reply: Thanks for the details. Export jobs under 10 GB normally complete within about an hour, and a job reporting as running for more than six hours is considered stalled (see our article "Data export jobs: expected duration and stalls"). Since EXP-40233 has been running roughly seven hours, we recommend cancelling it and resubmitting the export. Jobs are queued per region, so the resubmitted job will re-enter the eu-central queue. As a premium support customer, your ticket is handled in the priority queue with a four-hour first-response target during business hours in your region.
